output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    # primary object is the color other than 0 and line color; infer largest nonzero component/color
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x)
    # line is typically color with fewer cells; object is most frequent
    obj=max(cnt, key=cnt.get)
    # if tie/robust: object cells define bounding box
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==obj]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=0 and grid[r][c]!=obj:
          if r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1:
            if r==r0 or r==r1 or c==c0 or c==c1: out[r][c]=obj
            else: out[r][c]=grid[r][c]
          else: out[r][c]=0
    return out"}
